name: adder_pipe_bitwidth
description: Pipelined adder output sum is declared 8 bits wide ([7:0]) instead of the required 9 bits ([8:0]) to hold the full a+b range (max 511). For inputs a=200, b=200 the correct sum is 400, but the 8-bit register wraps modulo 256 yielding 144. Widening sum to [8:0] (and the output port accordingly) eliminates the overflow.
